title: Home app dispatcher
description: Handles JSON-RPC method calls for the Home application.
signature: fn call(app: &AppHandle, context: &CallContext, method: &str, params: Option<Value>) -> Result<Value, RpcError>
semantics: Implements home/state, home/tutorials, home/{new,open,clone}-project, home/{open-recent,forget-recent,close-project,initialize-project}, home/install-plugin, home/worktree-{state,create}.
